name: Fishin' Time
label: Quest
description: At Stormwind harbor, Gilbert Gray's bait runs low as the fish begin to bite. He asks passersby to fetch supplies from a shop along the city's canals.
intro: At Stormwind harbor, Gilbert Gray's bait runs low as the fish begin to bite. He asks passersby to fetch supplies from a shop along the city's canals.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.
Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the fishing supplies?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!
Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
